name: Definition Builder Domain Backfill
description: Backfill legacy oa-sdk domain specs into OpenAPI Definition Builder fragments and replace the existing merged OpenAPI artifact path.

userStories.title: Inventory legacy merge sources
userStories.description: As a schema maintainer, I want an inventory of the legacy merge inputs so that the fragment backfill has a complete source checklist.
acceptanceCriteria: List legacy profile files under packages/schemas/src/profiles.
List legacy domain specs under packages/schemas/src/domains.
List current shared components in common/spec.yaml.
List current paths and operations in health/spec.yaml.
List current paths and operations in users/spec.yaml.
Record current .merged.yaml path, .merged.3.1.yaml path, and validation commands.
Document which source sections map to definition fragment kinds.
userStories.notes: Inventory first to avoid partial migration of current domain sources.

userStories.title: Create parity target configs
userStories.description: As a builder user, I want target configs equivalent to the environment profiles so that builder output can generate the canonical OpenAPI artifact.
acceptanceCriteria: Add target config for local parity based on legacy packages/schemas/src/profiles/local.yaml.
Add target configs for staging and production if current profile files exist.
Target configs include stable name, scopes, domains, servers, and includePaths.
Local parity target includes all paths currently emitted by .merged.yaml.
Target config tests verify target selection includes expected direct paths and shared refs.
Legacy domain merge remained unchanged during parity and was removed after replacement.
userStories.notes: Keep target configs parallel to current profile files.

userStories.title: Backfill shared common fragments
userStories.description: As a schema author, I want common schemas, responses, parameters, and security schemes split into canonical fragments so that downstream domains can reference shared definitions by stable identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Convert common schemas into schema:shared/common/* fragments.
Convert common responses into response:shared/common/* fragments.
Convert common parameters into parameter:shared/common/* fragments.
Convert common security schemes into securityScheme:shared/common/* fragments.
Replace local shared refs inside fragments with oa://... canonical refs.
Tests verify common fragments register without duplicate canonical IDs.
Tests verify emitted shared component names match or intentionally alias merged output names.
userStories.notes: Shared fragments should be stable before domain fragments reference them.

userStories.title: Backfill health domain fragments
userStories.description: As a schema author, I want health domain paths and schemas represented as fragments so that health endpoints can be emitted by the builder.
acceptanceCriteria: Convert /health into a path fragment with canonical identity.
Convert /health/stream into a path fragment with canonical identity.
Convert HealthStatus into a schema fragment.
Replace refs to common responses/schemas with canonical refs.
Tests verify health fragments emit paths and components equivalent to builder output.
userStories.notes: Health has small scope and should prove path/schema fragment pattern before users.

userStories.title: Backfill users domain fragments
userStories.description: As a schema author, I want users domain paths and schemas represented as fragments so that user APIs can be emitted by the builder.
acceptanceCriteria: Convert /users into a path fragment with canonical identity.
Convert /users/{id} into a path fragment with canonical identity.
Convert User, CreateUserRequest, and UpdateUserRequest into schema fragments.
Preserve current request/response refs and operation IDs.
Preserve current pagination, filter, error response, and security refs.
Tests verify users fragments emit paths and components equivalent to builder output.
userStories.notes: Users domain is the primary current domain parity proof.

userStories.title: Add builder artifact workflow
userStories.description: As a release maintainer, I want a repeatable workflow that builds the builder artifact and records diagnostics so that replacement can be reviewed and maintained.
acceptanceCriteria: Add command or documented script to run oa-gen build-spec for the local parity target.
Write builder output to a parallel artifact path that does not replace .merged.yaml.
Emit diagnostics JSON and collision report JSON for the parity build.
Add normalized diff command or script comparing current .merged.yaml to builder output.
Tests cover successful builder artifact generation and at least one intentional diff case.
userStories.notes: Parallel artifact workflow is required before any replacement decision.

userStories.title: Validate compatibility gates
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the builder artifact to pass the same validation and downstream codegen gates as the merged artifact so that migration risk is visible.
acceptanceCriteria: Builder artifact passes the current schema validation flow.
Builder artifact can be downgraded to OpenAPI 3.1 with sidecar output.
Generated typegen output from builder artifact is compared with current generated output or documented accepted differences.
Router/client/mock-server compatibility checks run against builder artifact.
Any accepted drift is documented with rationale and owner.
userStories.notes: This story proves generated artifacts can be consumed by current downstream packages.

userStories.title: Document rollback and replacement criteria
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want rollback and replacement criteria documented so that builder ownership of .merged.yaml stays safe.
acceptanceCriteria: Document that merge.ts remained the active production path during parity work.
Document rollback path through git history after merge.ts removal.
Document the exact criteria required before builder output may replace .merged.yaml.
Update docs/internal/todo.md with the migration status.
Update docs/internal/spec.md with builder parity status.
userStories.notes: Replacement is not part of this PRD; document criteria only.

userStories.title: Final migration verification
userStories.description: As a release maintainer, I want final verification for the domain backfill migration so that builder output can own .merged.yaml.
acceptanceCriteria: Builder artifact has zero error diagnostics.
Normalized diff is accepted and documented.
No temporary test artifacts remain unless intentionally documented.
Remaining dirty files are documented if unrelated work exists.
userStories.notes: Final verification only. Do not add replacement scope here.
